title: Everyday Phrases — A Business Lunch
scene_zh: 商務午餐 · 情境對話
title_quote: I should invite the client to lunch.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🤝 實用商務午餐必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱B1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Business Lunch
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用商務午餐情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從邀約郵件、預訂包廂、談報價與交期，一路聽到送客與後續拜訪，400個實用句子一次聽飽。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多商務情境，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱＋按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical A Business Lunch phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the invitation email, the private room, budgets and delivery, and the follow-up visit. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more business scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I should invite the client to lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ʃʊd ɪnˈvaɪt ðə ˈklaɪənt tə lʌntʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a great way to build trust.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ɡreɪt weɪ tə bɪld trʌst./
dialogue.zh: 這是建立信任的好辦法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you email Mr. Chen today?
dialogue.zh: 你今天能發郵件給陳先生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what time works for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday noon is best for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll ask if Thursday suits him.
dialogue.zh: 我問問他週四合不合適。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please keep the email short and warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz kip ði ˈimel ʃɔrt ənd wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 郵件請寫得簡短又熱情。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, two or three lines.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mention it's a casual working lunch.
dialogue.zh: 說明這是輕鬆的工作午餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, say we'll discuss the new order.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, seɪ wil dɪˈskʌs ðə nu ˈɔrdər./
dialogue.zh: 要，寫上我們會談新訂單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did Mr. Chen reply to your email?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ˈmɪstər tʃɛn rɪˈplaɪ tə jʊr ˈimel?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He replied just ten minutes ago.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did he say about Thursday?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's pick a place near our office.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts pɪk ə pleɪs nɪr ˈaʊər ˈɔfɪs./
dialogue.zh: 選個離辦公室近的餐廳吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 第五街那家義式餐廳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's close and the food is good.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts kloʊs ənd ðə fud ɪz ɡʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need a private room for talking.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nid ə ˈpraɪvət rum fər ˈtɔkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我們需要包廂方便交談。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll check if they have one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask for a small room for six.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk fər ə smɔl rum fər sɪks./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does anyone have a food restriction?
dialogue.zh: 在場有人有飲食限制嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good question, I should ask politely.
dialogue.zh: 問得好，我該禮貌地問一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe add it to the email.
dialogue.zh: 或許可以在郵件裡加這句。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says no seafood for him.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should we ask about beef too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll ask, some clients skip beef.
dialogue.zh: 我問問，有些客戶不吃牛肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also check if they drink tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 所以六個位子，不多不少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, waiting on one reply.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The restaurant needs our names today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll call and book the room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask them to hold it till twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ðɛm tə hoʊld ɪt tɪl twɛlv./
dialogue.zh: 請他們保留位子到十二點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we prepare for Thursday?
dialogue.zh: 週四我們要做什麼準備？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe print the latest quote sheet.
dialogue.zh: 也許先把最新報價單印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea, bring two extra copies.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll put them in your bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we bring a small gift?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gifts aren't needed, but they're nice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who greets them at the door?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How early should we get there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's get there by eleven fifty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll wear my dark blue suit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 陳先生喜歡高爾夫，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 對，那是很好的寒暄話題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll practice some golf small talk.
dialogue.zh: 我來練幾句高爾夫寒暄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you book a car for them?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju bʊk ə kɑr fər ðɛm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already done, it picks them up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll text him an hour before.
dialogue.zh: 我會提前一小時發訊息給他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send him the restaurant address too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the room number as well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the restaurant easy to find?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's next to the subway exit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope the weather holds up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please confirm the menu with the chef.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz kənˈfɜrm ðə ˈmɛnju wɪð ðə ʃɛf./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll request mild and simple dishes.
dialogue.zh: 我請他們做清淡簡單的菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask for a vegetarian option too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你注意到這個細節。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have tea and sparkling water ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No alcohol, it's a work lunch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's seat Mr. Chen on my right.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts sit ˈmɪstər tʃɛn ɑn maɪ raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 把陳先生安排在我右手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 席位卡？有點太正式了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's review everything one more time.
dialogue.zh: 我們再把全部流程過一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 明天早上先對一次怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, nine in the meeting room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's go down and welcome them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mr. Chen, welcome, good to see you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪstər tʃɛn, ˈwɛlkəm, ɡʊd tə si ju./
dialogue.zh: 陳先生，歡迎，見到您很高興。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for the kind invitation.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll keep it safe in my card case.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl kip ɪt seɪf ɪn maɪ kɑrd keɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's head upstairs to the room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This way, please, mind the stairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's nice of you to say.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, we booked it for six.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 安靜又剛好，適合談事情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get you some tea?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's the menu, take your time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The grilled fish is their signature.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chef can adjust the sauce.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many mains do we need?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's also order a vegetable plate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll ask for fresh fruit then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two coffees, black or with milk?
dialogue.zh: 兩杯咖啡，黑咖啡還是加奶？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is your family, by the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ɪz jʊr ˈfæməli, baɪ ðə weɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, our order was a while ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi, ˈaʊər ˈɔrdər wʌz ə waɪl əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我們點單有一會兒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The main courses are still missing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The waiter says the kitchen is busy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwetər sɛz ðə ˈkɪtʃən ɪz ˈbɪzi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Could he check our order, please?
dialogue.zh: 請他幫我們催一下好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do have a schedule today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here comes the food at last.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me serve the dishes first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope everything suits your taste.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's see if everyone finishes first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like a little more?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll leave the last piece for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl liv ðə læst pis fər ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me pour it for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good food is worth the wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 水果和咖啡終於一起送上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, how is the new factory line?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, haʊ ɪz ðə nu ˈfæktəri laɪn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our team finished phase one last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər tim ˈfɪnɪʃt feɪz wʌn læst wik./
dialogue.zh: 我們上週完成第一階段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send reports straight to my assistant.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll set up the list.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I wanted to ask today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the price within your budget?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can talk about the numbers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me check with my manager.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have some room to move.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me explain the total cost.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I get a cost breakdown?
dialogue.zh: 可以給我一份費用明細嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Payment terms matter to us too.
dialogue.zh: 付款條件對我們也很重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們通常接受三十天付款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們財務部門希望四十五天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did your lawyers review the draft?
dialogue.zh: 你們律師審過草稿了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好，在你們那邊還是我們這邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The contract will be ready Wednesday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel we're close to agreement.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, today helped a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some topics need a light touch.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sports and travel are always safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you enjoy the golf weekend?
dialogue.zh: 那個高爾夫週末玩得開心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe a friendly match next month?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'd love that, let's plan it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How was your trip to Japan?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你們的新辦公室聽起來很明亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I read about your new product.
dialogue.zh: 我讀到你們新品的報導。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: People say you bought another factory.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That rumor isn't true at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Late October, or split the batch.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we can update the contract.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to settle up, I guess.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You hosted us just last month.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At least let us pay part.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they take a corporate card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The waiter says cards are fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you need a copy too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The receipt must show our company name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈsit mʌst ʃoʊ ˈaʊər ˈkʌmpəni neɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll ask them to print it right.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl æsk ðɛm tə prɪnt ɪt raɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll ask the cashier for it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這張發票是要報銷的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's for the expense report.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you email a scanned copy?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It goes into my expense folder.
dialogue.zh: 要放進我的報銷資料夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只收一成服務費，沒別的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll write the expense report tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Attach the invoice and the slip.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, thank you for the kind lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, θæŋk ju fər ðə kaɪnd lʌntʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you have a two o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me walk you to the elevator.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi wɔk ju tə ði ˈɛləˌveɪtər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們的車會在外面候著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It was a real pleasure today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Enjoy the rest of your day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you again for having us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did our guests get home safely?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He texted us both, all safe.
dialogue.zh: 司機傳訊息給我們，說都平安。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you draft it for me?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short and warm, like last time?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, thank them for their time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say the breakdown comes by Friday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add next steps for the contract.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mr. Chen replied in twenty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 陳先生二十分鐘就回了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He copied his whole team on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ˈkɑpid hɪz hoʊl tim ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 他把副本發給整個團隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should visit them next week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask if we can tour their new line.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ɪf wi kən tʊr ðɛr nu laɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can rent a van there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 還有修訂過的時程草稿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's confirm the visit by email.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll ask for a written confirmation.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So do I, let's prepare well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, the expense report.
